svg.text: Three ways to attach the motor adapter.
best yield and read length; most handling
a transposase inserts the adapter sequence
ten minutes, but tagmentation cuts the DNA
very gentle, very high molecular weight input
reads in the hundreds of kilobases
Whatever the route, the molecule ends up with a motor protein on one end — that end goes into the pore first.
Barcodes are ligated before the motor adapter, so a barcode is read at the start of every read.
